cycles.title: SPAGET Cycles
cycles.description: Schema for the SPAGET user planning cycle, storing diagnostics, incomes, and planned budgets.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this cycle.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when this cycle was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when this cycle was last updated.

challengeStartDate.description: The custom start date of the 21 days cycle (YYYY-MM-DD).

challengeEndDate.description: The automatic end date of the 21 days cycle (YYYY-MM-DD).

currentStage.description: The current step/stage of the user cycle.

stage1Confirmed.description: Whether Stage 1 is verified and locked.

stage2Confirmed.description: Whether Stage 2 is verified and locked.

stage3Confirmed.description: Whether Stage 3 is verified and locked.

stage4Confirmed.description: Whether Stage 4 is verified and locked.

/cycles/{cycleId}.description: Exhaustive user plan cycle containing state, budgets, fixed and variable expenses, and debts.
